# Zenra AI

> AI and software development studio. Zenra AI designs, builds and launches AI agents, custom AI tools, websites, web apps and online stores for businesses worldwide. It also makes Windows apps for creators: Zenra Video Downloader, Zenra AI Viral Clips and Zenra Video Splitter.

Key facts:
- Services: AI agent development, custom AI tool development, custom web development, and e-commerce store development (Shopify, WooCommerce and custom stores, plus monthly store management).
- Remote-first studio working with clients worldwide, in English.
- Fixed quotes in US dollars, paid by milestone; a working demo and a written update every week.
- Clients own the code, designs, domains and accounts from day one; NDA on request.
- Typical timelines: landing page 1–2 weeks; business website or online store 3–6 weeks; pilot AI agent 2–3 weeks; custom AI tool 4–12 weeks; web application 6–16 weeks.
- AI agents are built with approvals for important actions, human handoff, audit logs and least-privilege access.
- Replies to project inquiries within one business day.
- Contact: support@zenraai.com — https://zenraai.com/contact/

## Services
- [All services](https://zenraai.com/services/): AI agent development, custom AI tools, custom web development and e-commerce stores — designed, built and supported by one team, for clients worldwide.
- [AI agent development](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-agent-development/): Custom AI agents for customer support, sales and back-office work — connected to your apps, with approvals, logs and human handoff built in.
- [Custom AI tool development](https://zenraai.com/services/ai-tool-development/): Custom AI tools built on your own data: AI assistants, document extraction, knowledge search and AI features for your product — prototype first, fixed quote.
- [Custom web development](https://zenraai.com/services/custom-web-development/): Custom websites, web apps and landing pages — fast, secure, SEO-ready and easy to update. Modern frameworks, fixed quotes and a working demo every week.
- [E-commerce store development](https://zenraai.com/services/ecommerce-development/): Shopify, WooCommerce and custom online stores built to sell — payments, shipping, migrations, speed and monthly store management for brands worldwide.

## Products
- [All products](https://zenraai.com/tools/): Windows apps by Zenra AI: Video Downloader saves playlists and channels in 4K, Viral Clips turns long videos into shorts, and Video Splitter is free.
- [Zenra Video Downloader](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-downloader/): Windows video downloader for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X. Save playlists, channels and accounts in up to 4K or MP3. Free trial.
- [Zenra AI Viral Clips](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-ai-viral-clips/): Windows app that turns long videos into viral 9:16 clips: finds the best moments, keeps the speaker in frame, adds captions and titles. 30-day free trial.
- [Zenra Video Splitter](https://zenraai.com/tools/zenra-video-splitter/): Free Windows app that splits any video into equal clips in seconds, in original quality, with cuts at natural pauses. Ideal for Status, Shorts and Reels.
